# Fixture P3-FAIL-CAUSAL-ORDER (Regression R008)

During a foggy hike, Bo steps over a red rope to take a shortcut. Only after he has crossed does another hiker point to a sign that says the rope marks a boundary and must never be crossed. The trail then disappears and a bell rings from behind them, but the story never established that crossing the rope could cause either event. The group turns back without learning how to avoid the effect.
